evidence.title: CRM Admin Dashboard Template for Shadcn UI

name: CRM Dashboard
summary: Live demo of a CRM admin dashboard from Shadcn UI Kit: customer relationships, sales pipelines and performance metrics.
description: One of 16 dashboards in the Shadcn UI Kit pack, built with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui. The page is the live demo; the full dashboard set is a paid download ($79).
